content.short: Switching the Fear-Based algorithms for hope based influence.
content.description:
The crypto fairies aim to create a hope based future in the web3 space. With key focuses on equality and anti-bullying, we communicate and create content with a growing blockchain community.

Through social impact, we aim to switch the fear-based algorithms and hate of the past. So the future generations and users of the blockchain have a magical experience. With our 1,111 FairyFrens by our side we are going to conjure up some magic!
